lemma.statement: Let E/Q be an elliptic curve and p a prime. If S=Sel(Q,E[p^infinity]) and X=Sha(E/Q)[p^infinity], then corank_Zp S = rank_Z E(Q) + corank_Zp X. Consequently, if corank_Zp S=2, then rank_Z E(Q)=2 if and only if corank_Zp X=0; because X is cofinitely generated in this scope, this is equivalent to X being finite.
proof: Mordell-Weil gives E(Q) isomorphic to Z^r plus a finite group, where r=rank_Z E(Q).
Tensoring with Q_p/Z_p kills the finite summand and sends Z^r to (Q_p/Z_p)^r, so corank_Zp(E(Q) tensor Q_p/Z_p)=r.
Kim's displayed Kummer-Selmer sequence 0 -> E(Q) tensor Q_p/Z_p -> S -> X -> 0 is exact.

Pontryagin duality turns this into a short exact sequence of finitely generated compact Z_p-modules with the arrow order reversed. Z_p-rank is additive in a short exact sequence, giving corank_Zp S=r+corank_Zp X.
When corank_Zp S=2, nonnegative integrality gives r in {0,1,2} and corank_Zp X=2-r. Hence r=2 exactly when corank_Zp X=0.

The quotient X is cofinitely generated because S is; a cofinitely generated discrete p-primary group of corank zero has finitely generated torsion Pontryagin dual over Z_p, hence is finite. The converse is immediate.
scope: same elliptic curve E/Q and prime p throughout
rank equality only; no Sha-order or leading-term formula
nonclaims: No actual elliptic curve with infinite Sha[p^infinity] is exhibited.
No claim that exact Selmer corank two fails to imply rank two after adding an independent Sha-finiteness theorem.
No proof of Kim-Pollack Conjecture 1.6, Sha finiteness, BSD rank equality, or refined BSD.
No formal proof or independent peer review; this is a same-context hand proof checked against a primary displayed exact sequence.

attempted_implication_audit.exact_result_or_failure: The implication is not licensed by the Selmer dimension alone. The exact identity is corank Sel=rank E(Q)+corank Sha[p^infinity]. Therefore Selmer corank two leaves the alternatives (rank, Sha-corank)=(2,0),(1,1),(0,2), subject to any additional target theorems; the exact sequence by itself selects none.

attempted_implication_audit.scope: A logical sufficiency audit of the exact sequence. It does not assert existence of an elliptic curve realizing rank<2 and Selmer corank 2.
attempted_implication_audit.mathematical_falsifier: A counterexample to the lemma would be an E/Q,p for which Kim's exact Kummer-Selmer sequence has the usual Selmer meaning but corank additivity fails. For the stronger attempted implication, an actual E/Q with Selmer corank 2 and positive Sha[p^infinity] corank would falsify it; no such target example is asserted here.
attempted_implication_audit.repair_next_discriminator: After any complex-order-to-Kurihara-order theorem gives exact Selmer corank two, prove Sha(E/Q)[p^infinity] finite (equivalently corank zero) from hypotheses no stronger than the active root input, or prove rank E(Q)=2 by an independent rational-point mechanism. Do not treat exact Selmer dimension as rank equality before this discriminator.
